jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Excellent digital-health implementation fit centered on customer onboarding, cross-functional workstreams, data-feed integrations, stakeholder management, process building, and operational execution. Strong overlap with healthcare operations, onboarding, workflow coordination, training, and systems implementation.
jobs.gap: The posting prefers 5+ years in implementation/customer success/project management within digital health and benefits administration, plus deeper technical data-feed/integration experience. Emphasize transferable healthcare operations and systems work without overstating integration depth.

jobs.title: Platform Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Strong healthcare-tech implementation role covering enterprise software projects, cross-functional coordination, project planning, executive reporting, risk management, client engagement, and process improvement.
jobs.gap: EHR integration experience with platforms such as Epic/Cerner is preferred. Position healthcare workflow implementation, documentation, stakeholder coordination, training, and systems troubleshooting as the transferable core.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Operational Excellence
jobs.why: Very strong operations/process-improvement match involving healthcare programs, dashboards, reporting pipelines, SOP frameworks, vendor management, cross-functional execution, and measurable efficiency improvements.
jobs.gap: The role expects 4+ years of program/project management and stronger ownership of operational analytics and vendor strategy. Lead with healthcare operations, reporting, process design, automation, SOP development, and cross-functional project ownership.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Strong healthcare technology fit covering full-cycle implementations, workflow optimization, training, configuration, data migration, stakeholder coordination, documentation, and system adoption.
jobs.gap: The role asks for roughly five years plus hands-on EHR implementation/integration experience. The salary ceiling only modestly clears the target, and EHR configuration depth is a stretch area.

jobs.title: Program Manager - Care Management & Utilization Management
jobs.why: Strong payer/healthcare operations match spanning care management, utilization management, prior authorization, process standardization, business transformation, technology, compliance, and cross-functional program leadership.
jobs.gap: The role is more payer-domain heavy and may favor deeper direct Medicaid/Medicare/UM leadership experience. Emphasize healthcare intake/authorization workflows, managed-care exposure, process design, reporting, and cross-functional operations.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.why: Compelling healthcare growth-operations role focused on lead flow, CRM/data quality, Pardot/Salesforce administration, attribution, audience segmentation, automation, reporting, and AI-enabled workflows. It uses marketing experience without making SEO the core job.
jobs.gap: Hands-on Pardot/Salesforce administration and demand-generation operations are more specialized than the current profile. Emphasize CRM/workflow automation, reporting, data quality, website/digital operations, and cross-functional execution accurately.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare implementation opportunity centered on end-to-end deployment, customer onboarding, cross-functional coordination, stakeholder communication, project planning, and successful launch execution.
jobs.gap: The posting is relatively light on detailed requirements, so technical depth and healthcare-integration expectations should be validated during screening. Position implementation, onboarding, systems coordination, and healthcare operations as strengths.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager (Pardot Administrator)
jobs.why: Strong systems-heavy marketing operations role involving Pardot/Salesforce integrations, data quality, attribution, lead routing, workflow automation, AI-enabled processes, documentation, and cross-functional troubleshooting.
jobs.gap: This role expects deep hands-on Pardot, Salesforce, GA4, 6sense, and ZoomInfo ownership plus 5+ years in B2B marketing/revenue operations. Treat as a targeted stretch and do not imply tool proficiency beyond actual experience.

jobs.title: Lead Program Manager - GTM
jobs.why: Healthcare-adjacent GTM/revenue operations role combining program management, client experience, cross-functional coordination, implementation, operations, reporting, and process improvement.
jobs.gap: The role asks for 8+ years of program/project management and stronger GTM/revenue-operations tenure. Treat as a senior stretch and emphasize cross-functional operations, implementation, CRM/process work, and healthcare context without inflating tenure.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Local digital-health implementation role with strong overlap in project coordination, operational execution, healthcare technology, onboarding, stakeholder management, and process improvement.
jobs.gap: The lower portion of the salary range is below target, so compensation should be confirmed early. The posting may also expect more formal implementation tenure than the current healthcare role alone demonstrates.
